rule: Eligible non-SME NVOS payers pay quarterly advances for Q1-Q3 by 20th of next month; methods chosen for each impact type and declared for the following year.
exceptions: Check payer status, SME, IV-category-only operations, commencement of activity during reporting year, and art 16.4 clauses 5.1 and 5.2.
penalty: Late fee 1/300 key rate, capped at 0.2% per day; possible administrative liability art 8.41.
questions: Is the enterprise an obligated non-SME NVOS payer?
Does any exception or first-year exemption apply?
Does the selected calculation method match the previous declaration and was the advance paid by 2026-10-20?
caution: Existing legal obligation, not a new law. Do not confuse NVOS with ROP fees. Do not activate executable rule without regression tests.
